title: Expose developer-only bounded server-event search

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Developer server-event search tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/diagnostics/test_server_event_search.py

evidence_required: FT-009-AC-001 RED: no developer-only in-application server-event page exposes the accepted bounded fields or FT-008 navigation; GREEN: GET /staff/server-events applies the exact default/custom time, severity, component, event-code and exact Attempt/correlation filters, deterministic cap/order, developer-only current authorization, no-store rendering and accepted FT-008 links while every other role/direct/stale request discloses no rows; decisive comparison: seeded boundary/filter cases and the same synthetic rows requested by current developer, operator, photographer, unauthenticated, revoked and downgraded sessions plus browser navigation; artifact: filter, authorization and playwright evidence under .tasks/TASK-091-T3-FT-009-W2/.

FT-009-AC-004 RED: no page can show an important uncorrelated event without inventing an Attempt association; GREEN: rows with neither identity remain searchable and render no link, attempt_id rows use FT-008 detail, and correlation-only rows use the exact FT-008 correlation filter without a promo-table read; decisive comparison: all three identity shapes against rendered fields/links and provider call traces; artifact: correlation-shape evidence under .tasks/TASK-091-T3-FT-009-W2/.

.memory-bank/contracts/server-event-api.md#invalid-filter-response RED: no FT-009 adapter rejects every unknown, repeated, malformed, lone-time-bound and invalid/oversized-range class before persistence access; GREEN: each class returns no-store 422 with zero repository calls; decisive comparison: per-class status/header/body and provider spy count fixed at zero; artifact: focused invalid-filter evidence under .tasks/TASK-091-T3-FT-009-W2/.

.memory-bank/contracts/server-event-api.md#sanitized-internal-failure-response RED: no FT-009 adapter sanitizes event repository or HTML-render failures; GREEN: both injected branches return no-store 500 while response, server output and retained artifacts contain no traceback, cookie, credential, arbitrary payload or participant data; decisive comparison: injected branch/status/header/body plus redaction scan; artifact: focused internal-failure evidence under .tasks/TASK-091-T3-FT-009-W2/.
purpose: Deliver the complete minimal FT-009 investigation page while enforcing developer-only current authorization and preserving FT-008 as the sole Attempt detail owner.
success_outcome: An authorized developer can search at most 100 recent fixed-field event rows through the exact bounded route, follow truthful FT-008 navigation when correlation exists and see uncorrelated events without an invented link, while every denied or stale request reveals nothing protected.
anti_goals: Do not add a JSON API, event detail route, read model, pagination, arbitrary sort/query, full text, saved query, live tail, dashboard or export.
Do not embed FT-008 detail, read promo tables, validate correlation by foreign access or expose DiagnosticEvidence, annotations, Calibration, media or personalized sessions.
Do not add roles, generic RBAC, unsafe mutation/CSRF surface, production credentials/configuration or retention deletion.

forbidden_scope: Production staff credentials, server-event rows and unredacted retained browser/task artifacts
Promo Attempt/result/session writes, direct promo-table reads and FT-008 route/projection changes
Server-event collection/runtime, 30-day deletion, FT-010 annotations, FT-011 Calibration and new media delivery
stop_conditions: Business authorization/filtering cannot remain diagnostics-owned with platform/auth limited to current-principal authentication.
A correct page would require a JSON API, detail/read-model table, arbitrary query surface, new role or direct diagnostics read of promo tables.
Correlated navigation cannot reuse the exact existing FT-008 routes without changing their contract or disclosing target existence.
T3 authorization/browser probes cannot use disposable principals/rows, controlled downgrade/revocation, safe rerun, redacted artifacts and complete cleanup.

constraints: Primary owner and code root are diagnostics at src/face_moment/diagnostics/; the adapter obtains the current principal across diagnostics -> staff_access and backend only registers it.
Use only GET /staff/server-events with server-rendered no-store HTML, the exact filters/default interval/range cap and at most 100 newest rows.
Use existing GET /staff/attempts/{attempt_id} and GET /staff/attempts?correlation_id=... links exactly; FT-008 reevaluates authorization and target state.
Use playwright cli for the real filter/table/navigation and stale-role/stale-retention journey, storing only redacted synthetic transcript/screenshots under .tasks/TASK-091-T3-FT-009-W2/.
Use disposable developer/operator/photographer principals and synthetic event rows with known initial state, role downgrade/revocation, safe rerun and cleanup limited to those fixtures.
invariants: Current authentication and developer role are evaluated on every request; copied URLs and browser history grant no authority.
Diagnostics filters and renders only its immutable event projections; it never reads or writes promo tables and FT-008 remains the Attempt detail owner.
A missing correlation stays missing and has no link; a present identity is rendered exactly without participant/session payload.
Every response is no-store and exposes only fixed event fields; deleted/denied rows cannot reappear through stale browser content.
verification_targets: Focused repository/HTML fixtures prove exact default/custom time and field filters, conjunctive behavior, deterministic ties, 100-row cap, fixed columns and no-store responses.
T3 authorization matrix proves developer access and operator/photographer/unauthenticated/revoked/downgraded denial without existence disclosure or stale protected content.
Identity-shape fixtures and playwright cli prove FT-008 detail link, correlation-query link and truthful no-link behavior without a promo-table read.
Failure injection proves every invalid filter returns no-query 422 and repository/render failures return redacted 500, with no protected values in responses, output or artifacts.
